items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: Paul Bascomb did that back with a thing called 'Nona.'

ctx.x: (HUMMING). I thought that's what they were referring to when they said honking, with the -- you know, with the one note, the same note. Well, actually, I think he was about the first one that I heard do that from Texas, but Paul Bascomb did that back with a thing called 'Nona.'
